Direct symbolic differentiation gives sign N=2HA_x-AH_x. For p<=4 the t=x/(1-x) transformed quartic has exactly one sign change; for 4<p<16 positive coefficients on (0,1/2), negative on (3/4,1), and strictly negative N_x on the middle establish exactly one simple zero and a unique global maximum. The resultant Res_p(N,N_p)=-4x^2(x-1)^4(8x^2-7x+2)(16x^2+40x-23), together with N=N_p=0, gives the sole optimizer turn x=sqrt(3)-5/4, p=(64+48sqrt(3))/99. N(1/2,p)=p(p-4)/8 fixes the half-filling crossing; at (3/4,16), N_x=-72,N_p=3/2, H=(16-p)/8+2p(x-3/4)^2 and A->9/8 give the edge expansion and divergence. Independently recomputed quartic identities and resultant in exact symbolic arithmetic from the actual RESULT.md, not only verifier logs.
